additional_info.body:
Hello,
Yes, both charging points are indeed showing an error. My point is that the error codes reported on our monitoring system should have been “cable theft” and not “SECC is initializing”.
Since the cables were cut due to vandalism, we are handling the replacement at our own expense.
However, I need your help to understand why the incorrect error code is being displayed.
I hope my request is a bit clearer now.

additional_info.subject: 0476969 - ID0476969-DC/Si-D/FR- [Y2 / PN 312569868/06] Missing Error Receipts CRM:00472000544
additional_info.body:
Dear Thibaut,
The reported case happen in a charger running FW v8.0.5. Cable Theft Detection was released in the latest FW version v8.1.4.
That's explain why the OCPP message send was not the Cable Theft Detection. I suggest to request a FW update in your chargers if this an important feature to you.
Since no other task is pending from Service side I will proceed to close this ticket.
With best regards,
Joao Francisco Louro Cardoso
